Commentary.Commentary: That's it then from this game. India Women have the 1-0 lead in the three-match ODI series. The second game will prove to be vital as one team could seal the series and the other could level it. The next game will be played on Wednesday, the 21st of September in Canterbury. That game will begin at 5.30 pm IST (12 pm GMT) but our build-up will begin sooner. Do join us then. Take care and goodbye!

Smriti Mandhana (91 off 99 balls) is the Player of the Match. She says that she enjoyed her batting but she would have enjoyed it more if she would have stayed till the end. Adds that the ODI format is a natural game for her as it's more about timing the ball, in T20I she needs to keep a check on her strike rate. Mentions that it's good that Harmanpreet Kaur won the toss and they got to assess the wicket early, so she planned her batting accordingly. Concludes by dedicating her award to Jhulan Goswami and she says that the entire series they will be playing to dedicate to her.

Harmanpreet Kaur, the India Women captain says that they are really happy to get the support from the crowd and each one contributed well. Further says that the toss was very important as they won the toss and Jhulan Goswami was outstanding up front and she is very happy with that. Adds that Deepti Sharma is an experienced campaigner and she bowled well. Further says that Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia played well. That partnership was important for them and good to see each player contributing well both with bat and ball.

England Women skipper, Amy Jones says that she is disappointed with the loss, their main problem was that they did not get enough runs. Adds that they thought it was a tricky wicket, but India Women bowled well, and losing regular wickets cost them. Mentions that to get Shafali Verma early was important, but they needed more wickets. She praises the way Harmanpreet Kaur and Smriti Mandhana played. Ends by saying they need to perform better in the next game.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the game, Harmanpreet Kaur won the toss and put England Women into bat. This proved to be the correct choice as both Jhulan Goswami and Meghna Singh made good use of the early movement on offer. The scoring rate was kept in check throughout the innings and the spinners just didn't give an inch to the English batters. Danni Wyatt and Alice Davidson-Richards played a couple of good knocks in the middle and a couple of tailenders too were able to muster up some valuable runs but the score was still under-par. With just 228 needed to win, three half-centuries from amongst the top four batters meant that India Women got to the finishing line without breaking much sweat. Kate Cross and Charlotte Dean bowled well for the hosts but that was really it as the lack of wicket-taking opportunities cost them dearly. Stay tuned for the presentation...

England Women had their work cut out at the interval but they did get just the start they wanted as Kate Cross got rid of the dangerous Shafali Verma in the second over. But after that, their pacers were treated to some fine batting by the Indian batters and even their spinners couldn't provide the breakthrough. Charlotte Dean did get the breakthrough but by then they were already well behind in the game. The partnership between Kaur and Mandhana just put an end to any resistance put up by the bowlers and England Women will now look to bounce back in the next game.

India Women had the momentum coming into the chase as their bowlers had done a fine job but they lost Shafali Verma really early in the innings. It was then a quick 96-run stand between Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia that put them ahead in the game. Bhatia got to fifty and then got out but the skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur joined Mandhana in the middle and they too put on a 99-run stand. Mandhana looked flawless but gave her wicket away in the 90s. Harmanpreet Kaur though carried on and played a brilliant skipper's knock of 74 to take her team over the line.

India Women get there eventually and with time to spare as well. There was a bit of a stutter but not for long and they have been the better side in both innings and have gone 1-0 up in the three-match ODI series.

SIX! KABOOM! The skipper wraps the game off in style! A fuller ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on one knee and slog-sweeps it over the leaping fielder at deep mid-wicket for a biggie. India Women win by 7 wickets!
Slower ball, full in length, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward and blocks it out.
Fuller, around off. Harleen Deol blocks it.
Fuller length, around off. Harleen Deol hits it towards the cover.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards long on for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to sweep it but misses.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE! That was short, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur paddles it towards third man for a boundary.
Short, around off. Harleen Deol pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

On a length, angling in, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on her knee and looks to sweep this one but she misses and gets hit on the top of her pad. A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire disagrees. Amy Jones decides to go up for the review. No bat involved there, confirms, UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicates that it was going over the stumps. The on-fielder decision stands. India Women need 8 more off 42 balls.
Takes the pace off this one, serves another length ball, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur keeps this one out.
FOUR! Up and over! Cracking shot. Half-volley, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward and smokes it over mid off for a boundary.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur steers it towards third man for a single.
Another good stop! Width on offer now, slightly short. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it towards point. Emma Lamb dives to her left and stops the ball with her left hand. Only a single.
An overpitched delivery, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur flicks it wide of deep square leg. Tammy Beaumont runs to her, slides, and makes a good stop. Two taken.
Fuller length, around middle stump. Harmanpreet Kaur pushes it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! Outstanding short by the skipper. That was short, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur dances down the pitch and heaves it over deep extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller length, around middle. Harleen Deol pushes it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fuller length, on off. Harleen Deol blocks it.
Fuller length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep square leg for a run.
Tad fuller, outside off. Harleen Deol opens the face of her bat and guides it towards backward point. No run there.
Outside off, a length ball. Harleen Deol knocks it towards cover.

A length ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Harmanpreet Kaur tucks it gently towards square leg for a single. That will be fifty for Harmanpreet Kaur! It's been a solid knock so far. A perfect captain's knock.
Another pitched-up delivery, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur strides forward and blocks it out solidly.
Touch fuller now, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans forward and pushes it towards cover. No run there!
A good-length delivery, outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur dabs it towards point off the back foot.
Full and on the pads, clipped away towards short fine leg for a single.

Another reprieve for Harleen Deol! On the pads, nudged away towards square leg. Harmanpreet Kaur is quick to set off for the single but Deol is caught ball watching. The fielder over there picks up the ball but fails to hit the stumps at the bowler's end. Deol wasn't even in the frame.

NOT OUT! A good review by Harleen Deol and she survives! Sophie Ecclestone serves it on a fullish length and drifts it nicely into middle and leg. Deol looks to defend off the front foot but misses and gets pinged on the pads. There is an appeal from the bowler and the finger does go up. It is reviewed an UltraEdge confirms that there is a slight feather as the ball passed the bat.
Review! Harleen Deol has opted for a review against her LBW. UltraEdge shows a spike as the ball passes through the bat. The decision has to be overturned.
On a nagging length, a bit quicker and angling into the stumps. Harleen Deol backs away and cuts it towards point.
Around off, Harleen Deol watchfully keeps it out on the off side.
Slower through the air, on the shorter side and outside off, Deol taps it towards point.
Sophie Ecclestone (6-0-27-0) comes back to bowl.
Slower one, on a hard length and this one bounces a bit extra. Kaur dabs it down to the left of the keeper and looks for the single but Amy Jones stays sharp and prevents it.
Cross keeps it fuller and bowls it on off stump, Harmanpreet Kaur prods forward to make the block.
Fuller length, angling in from outside off. Deol opens the face of the blade and chops it down to third man for a run.
A tad fuller, around off and skidding through. Harleen Deol plays it late and keeps it out.
Around the top of off, Deol watchfully blocks it out.
Good length, outside off and a bit slower. Harmanpreet Kaur nudges it towards cover-point and sets off for the single. The throw comes in at the bowler's end and Kaur gets a blow on the thighs.
A dot to end Charlotte Dean's spell. Flighted, around off, Deol defends it out.
Fuller and at the stumps, driven through mid on for a single.
Tossed up, around middle and Kaur defends it out.

Did that carry? Hard to tell but that's a good effort by Issy Wong. Around middle, Harleen Deol looks to sweep but plays it uppishly towards short fine leg. Wong over there dives forward but fails to grab it. A single is taken and the replays show that it did indeed carry.
Dean holds it back a touch and bowls it around off, Harleen Deol keeps it out on the off side.
Flighted, full and around middle, Deol pushes it back towards the bowler.
Good length, outside off, this is punched away towards mid off. End of a successful over by Kate Cross, 3 runs and a wicket off it.
Length again, around the top of off, Kaur blocks it out.
A bit of a mix-up out there in the middle but no harm is done. Length, around off, Kaur guides it towards short third man. Harleen Deol though is off her bike but the skipper sends her back in time.
Harleen Deol comes to the crease.

OUT! CAUGHT! Smriti Mandhana gets out just 9 runs short of her ton and she will be very disappointed with that. Kate Cross keeps the length short and bowls it on middle and leg. Mandhana looks to pull off the front foot but she is way too early in her shot. The ball goes off the top edge and around the mid on region. Alice Davidson-Richards over there settles under it and takes it easily. End of a brilliant knock by Mandhana.
Commentary.Howout: c Alice Davidson-Richards b Kate Cross

Commentary.Commentary: WIDE! Kate Cross attempts the bumper but it goes well over Mandhana's head. Amy Jones is standing up to the stumps and pouches it amazingly after leaping up. Jones saves a certain boundary there.
Fullish length, on the pads, Kaur leans forward and wrists it past square leg for one more.
Length ball, around leg stump, Mandhana tucks it away towards deep square leg for a single.
Kate Cross is back on!
FOUR! Sweetly timed! This is looped up, full and outside off, Harmanpreet Kaur gets on the front foot and creams it through extra cover for a boundary.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Kaur looks to paddle it fine but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
Slower through the air and on the pads, Mandhana works it well in front of mid-wicket and for a single.
Around middle, knocked down to long on for a single.
Dean takes all the pace of the ball and loops it up well outside off. Kaur waits for eternity but gets beaten as shes looks to cut.
On the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur paddles it straight towards short fine leg.
Very full, speared in by Dean and around off. Kaur jams it back to the bowler.
A length ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out watchfully. India Women need 40 more off 90 balls.
SIX! BOOM! Lovely shot. A fuller ball, that's in the slot, around middle. Smriti Mandhana clears her front foot and dispatches this one over long on for a biggie.
Back of a length, down the leg side. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it gently towards deep square leg. A single taken.
Fuller one now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana slices this one uppishly towards sweeper cover for a single.
Another good-length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts that one towards backward point. A single taken.
Issy Wong begins her second spell with a length ball, nipping back in, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur manages to get an inside edge back onto her pads.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it back to the bowler.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it towards deep point for a couple.
Short, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it.
Lofted delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards deep cover for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it off the front foot.

DRINKS! It has been a fairly straightforward chase for India Women so far and with 53 runs needed off 102 deliveries, they should be able to get the job done with overs to spare. Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia set the game up beautifully and after Bhatia's departure, Harmanpreet Kaur has played the anchor role well. England Women have lacked control in the middle overs and just haven't created enough wicket-taking opportunities. They need wickets in heap and quickly too in order to stitch a comeback. With that said, Charlotte Dean has been brought back into the attack.
Another length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover and takes a single. She retains the strike.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! Kate Cross bangs it short now, around middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards fine leg. Alice Capsey runs to her left, and slides but fails to stop the ball. The ball rolls past her for a boundary.
Change of angle! Kate Cross comes from 'round the wicket, she serves a length ball, around middle. Smriti Mandhana works it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Bowl a length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur hangs back, opens the face of her bat, and guides it past point. A single!
Kate Cross drops it short now, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Pitched-up delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur strides forward and blocks it out watchfully.
Dot ball to finish the over. Fuller length, around the middle stump. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards mid-on.
Short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur guides it through third man for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it through cover for a run.
Short, wide outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it through point and a good stop by Alice Capsey in the deep certainly saves 2 runs for her team.
Fuller length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards mid-on.
Fuller length, angling in. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! A boundary ruins a good over from Kate Cross! Cheeky from Harmanpreet Kaur. Fuller ball, around middle and off. Harmanpreet Kaur gets low and scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Make that five dots! A good-length delivery, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur defends it towards cover.
Pitches it up this time, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur presents the full face of her bat and pushes it towards cover. Four dots in a row!
Beaten! Outside off, a length ball, at 104 clicks. Harmanpreet Kaur rocks back and looks to guide this one towards third man but she fails to get any bat on it.
Tailing back in, tad fuller, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur leans forward and blocks it out.
On a length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur stays in her crease and dabs it towards backward point.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it to mid-on.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards mid-on for a run.
Short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it to deep square leg for a run.
Fuller length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur drives it towards cover.
Short, around off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Short, wide outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it through point for a couple.
It will be pace from the other end as well! Alice Davidson-Richards comes back on!
Around the top of off, punched away towards cover.
Length ball, on middle, Kaur defends it out.

FOUR! Cross drifts onto the pads yet again, Harmanpreet Kaur just tickles it fine and Issy Wong from fine leg can't cut it off. A boundary and at the moment India Women are cruising through the run chase.
Fuller and around off, Kaur just looks to use the pace of the ball and ramp it past the keeper but misses.
Around the top of off, Cross takes pace off this one. Harmanpreet Kaur watchfully keeps it out.
Smriti Mandhana looks to go aerial but mistimes it badly. Pitched up on off, Mandhana hangs deep and looks to go over mid on but drags it towards wide mid on for a single.
TWO WIDES! This is full from Kate Cross and trying to attack the pads but spills it down leg. The keeper misses the ball as well and the batters get across for a run.
Kate Cross (4-1-16-1) is brought back into the attack.
FOUR! Easy pickings. That was short, down the leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it to fine leg for an easy boundary to end the over.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur knocks it towards mid-wicket for a quick single.
Play and a miss. That was short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur goes on the back foot and tries to heave it through mid-wicket but misses it.
Fuller length, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it.
Short of length, around leg stump. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards deep square leg.
Short, onto the pads. Harmanpreet Kaur pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Around middle, this is pushed back towards the bowler.
Misfield and they will get an extra run. This is shorter and outside off, Smriti Mandhana rocks back and cuts it past the diving fielder at backward point for another brace.
Tossed up, around off, Harmanpreet Kaur leans forward and eases it through extra cover for one more.
Just a fraction shorter and around off, this is pulled away behind square on the leg side for a run.
On off, punched away towards covers.
Drifting onto the pads, Smriti Mandhana stays back and works it towards deep backward square leg for a couple of runs.
Short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur tries to guide this one but misses it.
FOUR! Delicate! That was short, outside off. Harmanpreet Kaur opens the face of the bat in the last minute and guides it past short third man for a boundary.
Fuller length, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur blocks it off the front foot.
Short, around off. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana tries to guide towards the third man but she misses as the ball didn't bounce much.
Short, around off. Harmanpreet Kaur cuts it to point and a misfield costs a run.
On middle and leg, nicely swept away towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Another quicker and flatter one, around off, tapped towards point.
Here comes the arm-ball from Ecclestone, on off stump and Kaur just about manages to keep it out.
Very full from Sophie Ecclestone, on off, Harmanpreet Kaur brooms this one towards deep backward square leg and picks up a couple of runs.
Angling into middle and leg, Mandhana knocks it down to long on for one more.
Nicely flighted and on middle, Kaur prods and plays it towards mid-wicket for an easy single.
On the shorter side and around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur short-arm jabs it past square leg for one more.
Length, on off, defended out by Kaur.
This is dragged way down and outside off, the ball got stuck in Lamb's hand before she delivered it. Mandhana adjusts and manages to pull it through square leg for a single.
Missed opportunity! Emma Lamb drags one down on middle stump, Harmanpreet Kaur rocks back but pulls it straight towards deep mid-wicket for only a single.
Length now, around off, defended onto the off side.
Nagging length to start with, on off, Kaur plays it off the back foot and towards mid-wicket.
Emma Lamb comes into the attack. She replaces Charlotte Dean.
Sophie Ecclestone darts one in at the toes, Kaur flicks it towards mid-wicket for one more. There's half a shout for lbw from the bowler but it is turned down.
Fuller and around off, Mandhana brings out the cover drive and plays it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Tossed up on off, this is knocked straight to mid off.
Fuller this time, on middle, Harmanpreet Kaur gets down on one knee and connects the sweep shot well. The ball goes towards deep square leg and they get a run.
And again! Around middle and leg, Harmanpreet Kaur defends it out with soft hands.
Slower through the air and floated up around middle, Kaur keeps it out.
This is bowled around the pads, Harmanpreet Kaur stays back and nudges it onto the leg side for a quick single.
Drifting into middle, Kaur watchfully blocks it out.
Dean holds it back a touch and serves it on a length around middle. Mandhana waits for it and flicks it through mid-wicket for one.
This is dropped shorter and around off, Mandhana goes on the back foot and eases it behind point for an easy brace.
Fuller and around off, stroked away towards cover-point.

FOUR! Up and over! Smriti Mandhana brings up yet another half-century and that too in style. Flighted delivery, around off, Mandhana steps out and thumps it over mid off for a boundary. Mandhana holds the key here for her side.
Fuller and around the pads, Smriti Mandhana sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a run.
Nagging length, on off stump, Mandhana punches it back to Sophie Ecclestone.
Around off, stroked away towards silly mid off.
Drop and run! Around off, Harmanpreet Kaur just bunts it out on the off side and gets across quickly for the single.
Uppish but in the gap! Tossed up outside off, Mandhana steps out and lofts it over the cover region for just a single.
Length, around off, tucked away towards short mid-wicket.
Harmanpreet Kaur finding it difficult to rotate strike here. Nicely tossed up, on off and this is driven towards mid off. Just the single then off that over.
Around middle, this is flicked towards wide mid on where the fielder makes a good diving stop.
Three dots in a row now! Floated, outside off, this is pushed straight towards cover.
Going down the leg side, Kaur crouches and tucks it towards short fine leg.
Slower through the air and angling in from around off, Kaur solidly keeps it out.
This is angled onto the pads, Mandhana stylishly flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.
Around middle, Harmanpreet Kaur prods and makes the block.
Nicely drifted onto off stump, Kaur defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up, around off, driven towards short extra cover.
And again! Length, around off, this is scooped away towards fine leg for another brace.
Cheeky from Harmanpreet Kaur. On off stump, Kaur gets inside the line of the ball and just paddles it down to fine leg for a couple of runs.
Length, angling in from around off, this is punched through covers for a single. The 100 now comes up for India Women.
Floated up around off, Kaur leans in and drives it straight back towards the bowler.
Over the wicket now for the right-hander. On a nagging length and around off, Harmanpreet Kaur tentatively keeps it out on the off side.
Harmanpreet Kaur the skipper of India Women walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! Yastika Bhatia looked a bit edgy out there and she now departs after a brilliant start. This is tossed up by Charlotte Dean and angling onto off stump. Dean cleverly just pulls back the length a touch as well. Bhatia steps out and just looks to push it down the ground. Bhatia gets beaten in the flight and the ball goes on to hit the top of off stump. Can England Women build on this vital breakthrough now?
Flatter and close to the off stump, Yastika Bhatia looks to cut but misses.

EDGY FOUR! Charlotte Dean flights it up nicely around off, Yastika Bhatia steps out and looks to drive but gets an inside edge past the stumps. The ball runs away into the fine leg fence and that will be FIFTY for Bhatia, a brilliant knock so far from the southpaw.
Loopy delivery, on a nagging length and around off. Yastika Bhatia plays it late and manages to keep it out.
Slower through the air and drifted onto middle, Mandhana pushes it back towards the bowler.
On a good length and outside off, Bhatia stays back and taps it through cover-point for a run.
On a nagging length and around middle, Yastika Bhatia nudges it onto the leg side.
Length, on off, worked away in front of mid-wicket for one.
Intent straightaway from Smriti Mandhana against the left-armer. This is nicely flighted on off, Mandhana dances down the track and drags it wide off long on for a couple of runs.
Sophie Ecclestone starts off with a length ball around off, Bhatia guides it through backward point and collects a run.
Sophie Ecclestone is brought into the attack.
A tad bit quicker and close to the off pole, Mandhana looks to cut late but is beaten past the outside edge.
Flatter one, around off, this is pushed towards cover.
Length ball, on middle and leg, Mandhana hangs back and tucks it away leg side.
Tossed up on off, Yastika Bhatia steps out and drives it towards extra cover for one more.
Floated up around off, Mandhana strokes it away towards wide mid off for an easy single.
FOUR! Delicate touch from Smriti Mandhana! Shorter and outside off, Mandhana waits for it and just opens the face of the bat to guide it past short third man for a boundary.

DRINKS! India Women find themselves sitting in the driver's seat at the moment. They did lose Shafali Verma early in the innings, but Smriti Mandhana and Yastika Bhatia have scored freely since then. England Women need quick wickets in the next passage of play if they want to make a match out of it.
Fuller length, around off. Yastika Bhatia drives it towards the fielder at covers.
Short, outside off. Yastika Bhatia tries to guide that but misses it.
Short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana works it towards the third man for a run.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to the covers.
Short, around off. Yastika Bhatia tries to pull this one but mistimes it and the ball was in the air for a long time but just falls short of the fielder coming in from fine leg. Just the single then.
Short of length, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A single to end the over! Outside off, fuller in length. Smriti Mandhana leans in and strokes it towards sweeper cover for a run.
Outside off, fuller in length, Yastika Bhatia knocks it down to long off for a single.
Excellent stop! Pitched up again, outside off. Yastika Bhatia advances down and pushes it towards cover. Kate Cross there dives to her right and makes a terrific stop.
Outside off this time, fuller in length. Smriti Mandhana drives it through cover. Only a single.
Floats it up again, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana steps forward and pushes it towards mid off.
Flighted ball, full, around middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards mid off.
On a good length, around off. Yastika Bhatia knocks it towards mid-off.
Short of length, around leg stump. Smriti Mandhana knocks it towards deep square leg.
Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana knocks it to the covers.
Fuller length, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it through covers.
Short, around off. Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple.
Short, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards third man for a run.
Another loopy ball, full in length, around middle. Yastika Bhatia steps forward and pushes it towards mid on.

FOUR! Great use of the feet here! Charlotte Dean tosses it up, serves it full, around off. Yastika Bhatia dances down the wicket, gets to the pitch of the ball and drives powerfully past cover for a boundary.
Flighted delivery, full, around middle. Yastika Bhatia pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive but the ball goes off the inner half of the bat towards mid on.
Flatter, outside off again. Yastika Bhatia opens the face of her bat and dabs it away from the fielder at first slip.
Quicker, fuller, outside off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out watchfully.
Fuller length, around leg stump. Yastika Bhatia pushes it towards deep square leg for a run. A good over for India Women 12 runs coming off it.
FOUR! That's a gift from Alice Davidson-Richards. That was full, down the leg. Yastika Bhatia just clips it towards the fine leg for a boundary. India Women are shifting the gears.

SIX! A good strike by Yastika Bhatia. That was short, around the leg. Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards the square leg for a maximum. The fielder in the deep just gets her finger tip but was not able to pouch it.
Short, around the leg. Smriti Mandhana pulls it towards the square leg for a run.
Full, outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards the covers.
Fuller length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to the covers.
Time for Powerplay 2! England Women can now keep 4 fielders outside the inner circle till the 40th over.
Outside off, tosses it up, full in length. Yastika Bhatia leans in and drives it firmly towards cover. India Women are 59 for 1 at the end of the first Powerplay!

FOUR! Edgy runs! Another inside edge. Charlotte Dean flights this one, around off. Yastika Bhatia prods forward and looks to push this one away to the off side. But the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
Loopy ball, full, around middle and off. Yastika Bhatia prods forward to drive this. The ball goes towards mid on off the inner half.
Outside off, pitched up. Smriti Mandhana dabs it towards point. Single taken.
Tosses it up, full, around middle. Smriti Mandhana pushes it back to the bowler.
Charlotte Dean comes in from 'round the wicket, she serves a fuller ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia leans in to drive but the ball goes off the inner half towards fine leg for a single.
Charlotte Dean comes to bowl.

FOUR! Short ball and punished again! Alice Davidson-Richards serves another half-tracker, around middle. Smriti Mandhana swivels and pulls it towards deep square leg for another boundary. 50 up for India Women!
On a length, around off. Alice Davidson-Richards pushes it towards cover.
FOUR! Put away! Good shot! Alice Davidson-Richards drops it short, around middle. Smriti Mandhana picks up the length and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Around middle, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards mid on.
Full, wide of off this time. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive this one away from her body bu fails to get any connection.
Alice Davidson-Richards speeds in from 'round the wicket, she serves a fuller ball, in that channel outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it towards cover.

A good-length delivery, nipping in a tad, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia stays in her crease and looks to flick this one but she misses and gets pinged on her pads. A huge shout for LBW, but the umpire disagrees. Amy Jones opts for a review. Nothing on UltraEdge. The Ball Tracking indicated that was pitching outside leg. Not a great review from England Women here!
Pitched up again, around middle. Yastika Bhatia plays it back to Kate Cross.
Beaten! Full and outside off. Yastika Bhatia looks to drive this one but she misses and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Pitches this one up, angling in, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia closes the face of the bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Another length ball, outside off. Yastika Bhatia blocks it out towards cover-point off the back foot.
FOUR! Top shot! Stand and deliver. On a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia stays in her crease, opens the face of her bat, and punches it past point for a boundary.
Fuller one, outside off. Smriti Mandhana lets that one go through to the keeper.
FOUR! Oh, shot! Smriti Mandhana is timing the ball to perfection. Issy Wong offers width, serves a fuller ball. Smriti Mandhana lunges forward and drives it through cover for a glorious boundary.
Back of a length, darting it around the thigh pad. Yastika Bhatia pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Swing and a miss! Width on offer, a length ball. Yastika Bhatia looks to slash this one away but she misses.
FOUR! Crunched! Issy Wong drops it short now, around middle. Yastika Bhatia gets on top of that one and pulls it over mid-wicket for a cracking boundary.
Wide! Another wide in the over! Full, and wide of off. Yastika Bhatia offers no shot. Wided.
Angling in a length delivery, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia closes the face of her bat and taps it towards mid-wicket.
Wide! Wide of off, a fuller one. Yastika Bhatia leaves it alone. Wide called!
Angling in, around middle and leg, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana flicks it towards mid-wicket. Only a run off the over. Good one from Kate Cross!
Slightly shorter, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it off the back foot towards cover.
Around middle, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana shows the full face of her bat and defends it out.
Around the off pole, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana gets on top of that one and pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, a length delivery. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards point.

Leg bye! A length ball, angling in, around the leg pole. Yastika Bhatia misses her flick. The ball hits her pads and rolls away towards square leg. Leg bye taken. A stifled appeal as well for LBW, but the umpire says no.
A length ball, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
FOUR! Another beautiful drive from Smriti Mandhana! Tad fuller, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans in and drives it past mid off for a boundary.
Pitches it up, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana flicks it towards mid-wicket. No run there!
Leg bye! A yorker now, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia fails to dis this one out. The ball goes off her pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken!
Issy Wong drops it short again, around middle leg. Yastika Bhatia leaves it alone.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Yastika Bhatia gets a life. A short ball, down the leg side. Yastika Bhatia looks to pull this one. But the ball goes off her gloves towards the keeper. Amy Jones dives to her right, and manages to just get her glove on it. The ball rolls behind towards fine leg for a boundary.
On a length, around middle and leg. Smriti Mandhana taps it towards square leg. 11 runs off the over!
FOUR! Consecutive boundaries! It's off the back foot this time. Short and wide of off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and slashes it past point for another four.
FOUR! Oh, glorious! It's in the gap this time! Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana strides forward and creams her drive past extra cover for a gorgeous boundary.
On a length, outside off. Yastika Bhatia opens the face of her bat and guides it past point. A single!
Width on offer, fullish delivery. Smriti Mandhana lunges forward and drives it towards mid off for a single.
This one angles in, a length ball, around middle and leg. Yastika Bhatia tucks it towards square leg. Single taken.
Firmly driven but straight to the fielder! Fuller ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana prods forward and drives it towards extra cover.
Play and a miss! Slightly shorter, outside off, this one stays low as well. Smriti Mandhana looks to pull this one but she fails to get any bat on it.
Angling in now, much fuller, around middle. Smriti Mandhana miscues her drive towards the fielder at mid on.
Good-length deliver, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards cover off the back foot.
Edgy runs! Wide of off again, fuller in length this time. Yastika Bhatia leans to drive this but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man. A single taken.
FOUR! Put away! Width on offer, a length ball. Yastika Bhatia gets on top of that one and pushes it through point for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana rocks back and blocks it out. End of a successful first over from Kate Cross!
Fuller one, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes this one through cover. No run there!
Leg bye! Angling in, around the leg pole. Yastika Bhatia looks to flick this one but she misses. The ball goes off her pads towards fine leg. Leg bye taken!

OUT! TAKEN! Kate Cross draws first blood! The dangerous Shafali Verma departs without troubling the scorers much. A terrific catch from Charlotte Dean! Kate Cross bowls a fuller ball, angling in, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma flicks this one uppishly away from mid-wicket. Charlotte Dean there, leaps to her left and takes a stunning catch with both her hands.
Commentary.Howout: c Charlotte Dean b Kate Cross

Commentary.Commentary: Yastika Bhatia is the new batter in.
Wide! Takes the pace off this time, and spills it down the leg side, Shafali Verma misses her flick. Wided.
Outside off, another length ball. Shafali Verma pushes it towards cover.
Kate Cross begins with a length ball, around middle and leg. Shafali Verma clips it towards mid-wicket.
Kate Cross will bowl from the other end.
Swinging away from the left-hander, outside off, a length ball. Smriti Mandhana is happy to let that one go.
Swinging in, around middle and leg, on a length. Shafali Verma looks to flick but the ball goes off the leading edge well way from cover. Only a single.
Angling in now, around middle and leg, on a length. Shafali Verma blocks this one towards the off side with an angled bat.
A good-length delivery, around off. Shafali Verma keeps this one out.
Much fuller now, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leans to drive but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a single. Smriti Mandhana and India Women are underway!
Issy Wong begins with a length ball, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
